author: DJI
description:
In July 2025, the research vessel Perseverance proved that combining satellite imagery with DJI Enterprise drones creates a powerful new dataset for glaciology. By deploying the Mavic 3 Enterprise, the team captured high-precision photogrammetry data across several glacial environments. 

This is a testament to how professional-grade drone technology is no longer just for cinematography—it’s a critical tool for understanding our changing planet.

#DJIEnterprise #ClimateScience #Mavic3E #Glaciology #Drone #Greenland #TechForGood #unesco #GlaciersDay

👉 Learn more about DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise: https://enterprise.dji.com/mavic-3-enterprise
